FLEinladungZeile.description: One live link as the team's read serves it: the stored row, its minter withheld where the ban list holds that address.

FLEinwilligung.title: FLEinwilligung
FLEinwilligung.description:
What this person agreed may be published about them.

The keys the validator requires stand TOGETHER, as `FLAustritt` does: a scope with no
confirmation date claims somebody consented, and no surface can tell that from one somebody gave.

FLEinwilligungBeleg.title: FLEinwilligungBeleg
FLEinwilligungBeleg.description: When a person set one consent choice, and under which wording.

FLEinwilligungFassung.title: FLEinwilligungFassung
FLEinwilligungFassung.description:
The words one consent label names, as the person stamping it was shown them.

Never changed once served: different words are a new label.

FLEinwilligungNachweis.title: FLEinwilligungNachweis
FLEinwilligungNachweis.description: The evidence one consent choice keeps: the act that set its value, and on a withdrawal the grant it ended.

FLEinwilligungNachweise.title: FLEinwilligungNachweise
FLEinwilligungNachweise.description: Each choice's evidence, null until its person sets it: a record no person has answered carries none.

FLEinwilligungSeitenResponse.title: FLEinwilligungSeitenResponse
FLEinwilligungSeitenResponse.description: The label each page stamps on a new acceptance today, which a deploy moves: never cached by a reader.

FLEinwilligungStand.title: FLEinwilligungStand
FLEinwilligungStand.description:
Each choice's stand where the account page was served, null where the record carried no evidence for it.

A consent PATCH's precondition, echoed back as served, never a secret (`docs/backend/spec.md :: I995`).

FLGenerateSpielplanPayload.title: FLGenerateSpielplanPayload
FLGenerateSpielplanPayload.description:
Whether this draw may REPLACE what the season already holds, and the shape it runs from.

An absent body is a first draw off the season's own rules: nothing is destroyed and no
number moves by omission. `REQ-SPIELPLAN-005` bounds a confirmed one.

FLGenerateSpielplanResponse.title: FLGenerateSpielplanResponse
FLGenerateSpielplanResponse.description:
What the draw wrote, and what a confirmed replace deleted first, flat rather than nested.

An admin reads the written counts without a second request, and they are the same numbers the
season's own watermark keeps, so the two can be compared by eye.

FLGesperrtPayload.title: FLGesperrtPayload
FLGesperrtPayload.description: The one address a message is about to go to.

FLGesperrtResponse.title: FLGesperrtResponse
FLGesperrtResponse.description: Whether a standing ban holds that address, and nothing of any record: the mailer needs none.

FLGruppen.title: FLGruppen
FLGruppen.description:
Every group the SEASON offers, all of them and no other, in standing order.

Built by `fl_backend/app/api/teams/services.py :: build_gruppen` alone: the order is the tiebreak
chain, whose head-to-head criterion reads the season's matches.

FLGruppenTeam.title: FLGruppenTeam
FLGruppenTeam.description:
One row of a league table: what a standing shows and nothing more.

Narrower than `FLTeam` on purpose: a public CLIENT component renders this, so every field is
serialised into the page, and a club's address is a school's street.

FLKaderResponse.title: FLKaderResponse
FLKaderResponse.description: A team's squad for one season, live and ausgetragen rows alike, with the Stufen the season's rules offer.

FLKaderZeile.title: FLKaderZeile
FLKaderZeile.description:
One squad row as its team's seat holder reads it (`READ-KADER-001`).

Declared from nothing rather than a public model unmasked, so the whole surname reaches no
base-tier model, and no address or telephone number reaches this one.

FLKaderZeileResponse.title: FLKaderZeileResponse
FLKaderZeileResponse.description: The row as a representative's edit or austragen left it, its shirt marker judged against the squad after the write.

FLKontaktEinladenResponse.title: FLKontaktEinladenResponse
FLKontaktEinladenResponse.description: A fresh link for one seat, and its pair where the Trainer holds both; the old link then opens nothing.

FLKontaktErasureAnsichtResponse.title: FLKontaktErasureAnsichtResponse
FLKontaktErasureAnsichtResponse.description:
Whom `POST /kontakte/erasure` would reach, and nothing it would destroy.

The two lists are the two collections the write clears, kept apart because an application is a
request to join and a junction row is a season already played.

FLKontaktErasurePayload.title: FLKontaktErasurePayload
FLKontaktErasurePayload.description:
Which person is asking to be forgotten, named by the one field that joins their records.

A contact block carries no id and nothing joins one season's Trainer to the next season's, so
the address IS the identity here.

FLKontaktErasureResponse.title: FLKontaktErasureResponse
FLKontaktErasureResponse.description:
What the erasure reached, and NOT an echo of the person.

`app/api/spieler/schemas.py :: FLSpielerErasureResponse`'s reason, binding harder here: the
request named an address, so echoing anything of theirs returns a copy of what was destroyed.

FLKontaktKenntnisnahme.title: FLKontaktKenntnisnahme
FLKontaktKenntnisnahme.description:
Which wording this person was shown, and how the record came to be held.

Kenntnisnahme and not Einwilligung: the published basis is Art. 6(1)(b)/(f), and the pupil's
`fl_backend/app/api/spieler/schemas.py :: FLEinwilligung` holds other values entirely
(`docs/glossary.md :: Einwilligung`).

FLKontaktMint.title: FLKontaktMint
FLKontaktMint.description: One person's fresh confirmation link, RAW, for the admin action to mail; it is answered here and in no other response, ever.

FLKontaktSitz.title: FLKontaktSitz
FLKontaktSitz.description:
One seat the address holds.

Per seat and not per person: one person holds seats in several seasons, and one row seats them
twice where `trainer_ist_zugleich` says so, so a list keyed on the name hides both cases.

FLKontaktperson.title: FLKontaktperson
FLKontaktperson.description: One person the league reaches this team through, for one season.

FLKontoBewerbungSitzEinwilligung.title: FLKontoBewerbungSitzEinwilligung
FLKontoBewerbungSitzEinwilligung.description:
One pending application on which the address holds a confirmed contact seat, with its two choices to withdraw.

Pending alone: an accepted application's seats are its season row's, listed under `sitze`.

FLKontoEinwilligungenResponse.title: FLKontoEinwilligungenResponse
FLKontoEinwilligungenResponse.description:
Every confirmed consent record the signed-in address holds, for the account page; empty where it holds none.

The referees a list where the pupil is one: `spieler.email` is unique, a referee's typed address is not.

FLKontoRegistrierungEinwilligung.title: FLKontoRegistrierungEinwilligung
FLKontoRegistrierungEinwilligung.description: One pending registration its pupil confirmed: its choices to withdraw, and what it stores.

FLKontoSitzEinwilligung.title: FLKontoSitzEinwilligung
FLKontoSitzEinwilligung.description:
One team season on which the address holds a confirmed contact seat, with its WhatsApp and media choices.

Per season row and not per slot: one person holding two of a row's slots answers one choice for both.

FLOffeneRegistrierung.title: FLOffeneRegistrierung
FLOffeneRegistrierung.description: One pending registration as the team deciding it reads it.

FLOffeneRegistrierungenResponse.title: FLOffeneRegistrierungenResponse
FLOffeneRegistrierungenResponse.description: One team's pending registrations for one season, and whether that is the whole of them.

FLPatchKaderZeilePayload.title: FLPatchKaderZeilePayload
FLPatchKaderZeilePayload.description:
What a team's seat holder may change on a live squad row, WHOLESALE for `FLPatchSpielerPayload`'s reason.

Never `_SaisonSpielerPayload`'s child, which carries `team_id`: a representative moves no pupil
to another team, and `extra="forbid"` refuses that key.

FLPatchSaisonSpielerPayload.title: FLPatchSaisonSpielerPayload
FLPatchSaisonSpielerPayload.description:
Replaces the squad row WHOLESALE — see `FLPatchSpielerPayload` for why nothing has a default.

`team_id` is editable here: a mid-season transfer is a change to the junction row.

FLPatchSaisonTeamKontaktePayload.title: FLPatchSaisonTeamKontaktePayload
FLPatchSaisonTeamKontaktePayload.description:
The contact block alone, plus the token naming which block it was composed against.

`extra="forbid"`: a `gruppe` or an `austritt` sent here is a 422 rather than a value this
endpoint was never asked to decide.

kontakte_stand.title: Kontakte Stand
kontakte_stand.description: The AFTER image's token: this save has moved the row past what its caller read, so an undo of it can replay against no other.

FLPatchSaisonTeamKontakteResponse.title: FLPatchSaisonTeamKontakteResponse
FLPatchSaisonTeamKontakteResponse.description:
The block as STORED after the write, its row, and the links it minted.

No other field off that row: the caller sent none, and echoing one would invite a client to
believe this endpoint owns it.

FLPatchSaisonTeamPayload.title: FLPatchSaisonTeamPayload
FLPatchSaisonTeamPayload.description:
The row's own fields. NO `kontakte`: `FLPatchSaisonTeamKontaktePayload` owns it.

A stored contact is shapeless on read and bounded on write, so round-tripping it here refuses
every save a club with one bad row can make.

FLPatchSpielDataResponse.title: FLPatchSpielDataResponse
FLPatchSpielDataResponse.description:
What `patch_spiel_data` returns: every fixture it moved, and what that cost.

Both lists report writes the caller did not ask for, each carrying the result it destroyed.

FLPatchSpielPaarungPayload.title: FLPatchSpielPaarungPayload
FLPatchSpielPaarungPayload.description:
One fixture of a replay: its Paarung and the fields this entry names beyond it, leaving every other field as stored.

Its own route rather than a mode on the wholesale patch, where naming a field is what OVERWRITES it.

FLPatchSpielePaarungenPayload.title: FLPatchSpielePaarungenPayload
FLPatchSpielePaarungenPayload.description: Restore every fixture one save moved, in the order the report named them.

FLPatchSpielePaarungenResponse.title: FLPatchSpielePaarungenResponse
FLPatchSpielePaarungenResponse.description:
What a whole replay cost beyond the fixtures it was asked to restore, and the season's faults once it had.

No `prior_paarungen`: a restore this reports would be an undo of an undo, which no surface offers
(`fl_frontend/src/shared/utils/undoDispatch.ts :: offerUndo`).

FLPatchSpielerPayload.title: FLPatchSpielerPayload
FLPatchSpielerPayload.description:
Replaces the person's names WHOLESALE.

The handler `$set`s this model's dump, so a field with a default would let a form that forgot it
write that default over a stored value.

FLPostBewerbungPayload.title: FLPostBewerbungPayload
FLPostBewerbungPayload.description:
One school's application, as the public form submits it.

`status`, `eingereicht_am` and `entscheidung` are on no payload: the server sets all three, so a
client can neither arrive already accepted nor backdate its own submission.

FLPostBewerbungResponse.title: FLPostBewerbungResponse
FLPostBewerbungResponse.description:
What the submission wrote, and nothing the submission carried.

The three people's details went one way, and a body repeating them is a copy in a browser's
cache and in every proxy between.

FLPostRegistrierungPayload.title: FLPostRegistrierungPayload
FLPostRegistrierungPayload.description:
One pupil registering through a team's link.

The league's own fields -- the team, the season, the state, the deadline and the confirmation
link -- are taken off the invite and the clock, never off this body.

FLPostRegistrierungResponse.title: FLPostRegistrierungResponse
FLPostRegistrierungResponse.description:
The stored registration and a raw confirmation link, which no read ever answers.

The database holds its hash alone, so a lost link is re-minted by the sweep's reminder rather
than recovered from any read.

FLPostSaisonSpielerPayload.title: FLPostSaisonSpielerPayload
FLPostSaisonSpielerPayload.description:
One player's membership of one team's squad for one season.

Every field is required, including those a squad often does not know: a caller states `null`
rather than omitting, so the answer is theirs and not a default nobody chose.

FLPostSaisonTeamPayload.title: FLPostSaisonTeamPayload
FLPostSaisonTeamPayload.description: One team's membership of one season. `team_id` comes from the path, `saison_id` from here.

FLPostSperrlisteResponse.title: FLPostSperrlisteResponse
FLPostSperrlisteResponse.description: Answers the bound as well as the id: the mail telling the person names the season, and a second read would race the lapse.

FLRegistrierung.title: FLRegistrierung
FLRegistrierung.description:
One pupil's registration for one team's season, as stored, its decision as served.

The submission is never rewritten: its pupil fills and withdraws `einwilligung` and fills
`geburtsdatum`, and a decline writes `status` and `entscheidung`.

FLRegistrierungAblehnenPayload.title: FLRegistrierungAblehnenPayload
FLRegistrierungAblehnenPayload.description: Why the team declines, from a closed set or not at all.

FLRegistrierungAblehnungResponse.title: FLRegistrierungAblehnungResponse
FLRegistrierungAblehnungResponse.description: What the decline mail needs, answered to the frontend's server and never further.

FLRegistrierungAufnahmeResponse.title: FLRegistrierungAufnahmeResponse
FLRegistrierungAufnahmeResponse.description: The squad entry the admission wrote, and the person it belongs to.

FLRegistrierungAufnehmenPayload.title: FLRegistrierungAufnehmenPayload
FLRegistrierungAufnehmenPayload.description: The team's answer to the question the read asked: the person this registration is admitted into, or none.

FLRegistrierungBestaetigung.title: FLRegistrierungBestaetigung
FLRegistrierungBestaetigung.description:
One registration's confirmation bookkeeping as an administrator reads it -- and NO `token_hash`.

The hash is a raw document key the confirmation query alone reads, as
`app/api/bewerbungen/schemas.py :: FLBewerbungBestaetigung` keeps its own off the wire.

FLRegistrierungBestaetigungAnsichtPayloa.title: FLRegistrierungBestaetigungAnsichtPayload
FLRegistrierungBestaetigungAnsichtPayloa.description: A POST that reads: the token travels in a body, never in a second URL.

FLRegistrierungBestaetigungAnsichtRespon.title: FLRegistrierungBestaetigungAnsichtResponse
FLRegistrierungBestaetigungAnsichtRespon.description: What one confirmation link opens, and no field past the ones declared here (`docs/backend/spec.md :: I286`).

FLRegistrierungBestaetigungPayload.title: FLRegistrierungBestaetigungPayload
FLRegistrierungBestaetigungPayload.description: One pupil's own answer: their date of birth, and on the new pupil's page the two consents that stand under one record.

FLRegistrierungBestaetigungResponse.title: FLRegistrierungBestaetigungResponse
FLRegistrierungBestaetigungResponse.description: What the pupil just recorded, echoed so the answer panel states it rather than opening the link a second time.

FLRegistrierungEinwilligung.title: FLRegistrierungEinwilligung
FLRegistrierungEinwilligung.description:
A pending registration's consent record, each choice and `datum` optional here alone.

A returning pupil's page asks no choice (`docs/backend/spec.md :: I_NEW_KONTO-B3_1`).

FLRegistrierungEntscheidungZeile.title: FLRegistrierungEntscheidungZeile
FLRegistrierungEntscheidungZeile.description: A decision as the list serves it: the stored one, its decider withheld where the ban list holds that address.

FLRegistrierungPerson.title: FLRegistrierungPerson
FLRegistrierungPerson.description: The stored person a confirmed registration's address resolves to, named so the team can be asked whether it is the same one.

FLRegistrierungSelbstEinwilligungPayload.title: FLRegistrierungSelbstEinwilligungPayload
FLRegistrierungSelbstEinwilligungPayload.description: The pupil's own two choices on one pending registration, the pupil's account control's shape: a grant is refused.

FLRegistrierungSelbstEinwilligungRespons.title: FLRegistrierungSelbstEinwilligungResponse
FLRegistrierungSelbstEinwilligungRespons.description: The registration's consent record as it stands after the write, everything the pupil did not move unchanged.

FLRegistrierungSweepBenachrichtigung.title: FLRegistrierungSweepBenachrichtigung
FLRegistrierungSweepBenachrichtigung.description:
One pupil whose confirmed registration was erased at its season's end, and who is told after the fact.

No token and no deadline: the row is gone, and this message asks for nothing.

FLRegistrierungSweepErinnerung.title: FLRegistrierungSweepErinnerung
FLRegistrierungSweepErinnerung.description:
One reminder to send: a pupil whose link has reached its reminder age and who has not answered it.

The token is the RAW fresh one (`docs/backend/spec.md :: I296`).

FLRegistrierungSweepResponse.title: FLRegistrierungSweepResponse
FLRegistrierungSweepResponse.description:
One season's pass: the reminders already stamped, the erasures already made, and the one note each of them owes.

The ordering that makes those three true is `docs/backend/spec.md :: I297`.

FLRegistrierungVorschlag.title: FLRegistrierungVorschlag
FLRegistrierungVorschlag.description:
The one stored person holding no address whose name is the registration's: proposed, never resolved.

"A typed name is a weaker key than a shorthand", so a name only ever proposes.

FLRegistrierungenListResponse.title: FLRegistrierungenListResponse
FLRegistrierungenListResponse.description: The pending rows, newest first, and whether that is the whole of them.

FLReplaceSaisonTeamPayload.title: FLReplaceSaisonTeamPayload
FLReplaceSaisonTeamPayload.description: Which club takes this season's row over. The path names the club going OUT.

FLReplaceSaisonTeamResponse.title: FLReplaceSaisonTeamResponse
FLReplaceSaisonTeamResponse.description:
The junction row as the replacement left it, plus what it reached beyond that row.

`austritt` is cleared and not echoed: a club that has not withdrawn needs nothing done about it.

FLSaisonBewerbung.title: FLSaisonBewerbung
FLSaisonBewerbung.description:
When the league accepts applications for this season.

The two halves that record it: the span, and the `offen` flag an administrator sets beside it.

FLSaisonForfeitErgebnis.title: FLSaisonForfeitErgebnis
FLSaisonForfeitErgebnis.description:
What a fixture is awarded when one side does not appear.

Both sides' goals rather than a margin, composed at `app/api/spiele/services.py :: apply_payload_to_spiel`.
A LEVEL award needs a season with no knockout round (`REQ-RULES-010`).

FLSaisonPhaseSchedule.title: FLSaisonPhaseSchedule
FLSaisonPhaseSchedule.description:
One phase of a season: how many matchdays it takes, and how many matches each holds.

A phase the bracket does not reach is ABSENT rather than present with zeroes, so the list IS the
phases the season plays, in playing order.

FLSaisonRegistrierung.title: FLSaisonRegistrierung
FLSaisonRegistrierung.description:
When a pupil may register for this season.

Its own model rather than an alias of `FLSaisonBewerbung` above: the two windows are two
decisions an administrator takes apart, and one component name on both would publish them as one.

FLSaisonSpielerResponse.title: FLSaisonSpielerResponse
FLSaisonSpielerResponse.description: A junction row, which has no read model of its own -- so it is echoed as it was written.

FLSaisonSpielplan.title: FLSaisonSpielplan
FLSaisonSpielplan.description:
What the generator left behind on the season it wrote.

Counts rather than a hash: these are the two numbers an admin can compare against the page in
front of them, and a hash answers no question anyone standing there is asking.

FLSaisonTeamEinwilligungAntwortResponse.title: FLSaisonTeamEinwilligungAntwortResponse
FLSaisonTeamEinwilligungAntwortResponse.description:
What an answer on a season row's link did, and nothing to compose a message from.

No application stands behind the seat, so nobody is told.

FLSaisonTeamKontakte.title: FLSaisonTeamKontakte
FLSaisonTeamKontakte.description:
The three people a team is reached through, for ONE season.

On the junction rather than the club: a school's staff turns over between seasons, and a
finished season is the record of who was reachable while it ran.

FLSaisonTeamKontaktePayload.title: FLSaisonTeamKontaktePayload
FLSaisonTeamKontaktePayload.description:
The write side of the three, with the empty slot an erasure leaves.

Three whole people is the editor's own guarantee
(`fl_frontend/src/features/kontakte/components/forms/AdminKontakteEditForm/FormKontakteSection.tsx`).

FLSaisonTeamPersonEinwilligungResponse.title: FLSaisonTeamPersonEinwilligungResponse
FLSaisonTeamPersonEinwilligungResponse.description: Which of the row's seats the press reached, and the two answers they now all hold.

FLSaisonTeamResponse.title: FLSaisonTeamResponse
FLSaisonTeamResponse.description: A junction row, which has no read model of its own -- so it is echoed as it was written.

FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechsel.title: FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechsel
FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechsel.description:
A confirmed referee's address waiting on its own mailbox, as the editor reads it -- and NO `token_hash`.

Kept off the wire for `FLSchiedsrichterBestaetigung`'s reason.

FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselAnsichtResp.title: FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselAnsichtResponse
FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselAnsichtResp.description:
What one address link opens, and nothing a leaked one should not learn (`READ-REFEREE-003`).

A first name and a deadline: never either address, the school, the fee or the id.

FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselMint.title: FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselMint
FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselMint.description:
A freshly minted address link, answered once, with the address the change was asked from.

The caller tells the stored address that a change was asked, so a change nobody wanted is
noticed by the person still holding the record.

FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselMintRespons.title: FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselMintResponse
FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselMintRespons.description: The address link's re-send answer. Never null: where no change is pending a 404 answers instead.

FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselResponse.title: FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselResponse
FLSchiedsrichterAdresswechselResponse.description: The answer recorded, and nothing of the row: a leaked link learns only what it posted.

FLSchiedsrichterBestaetigung.title: FLSchiedsrichterBestaetigung
FLSchiedsrichterBestaetigung.description:
One referee's confirmation bookkeeping as the editor reads it -- and NO `token_hash`.

The hash is a raw document key the confirm query alone reads, as
`app/api/bewerbungen/schemas.py :: FLBewerbungBestaetigung` keeps its own off the wire.

FLSchiedsrichterBestaetigungAnsichtRespo.title: FLSchiedsrichterBestaetigungAnsichtResponse
FLSchiedsrichterBestaetigungAnsichtRespo.description:
What one confirmation link opens, and nothing a leaked one should not learn (`READ-REFEREE-002`).

A first name and a role: never the full name, the school, the contact details, the fee, the
birthdate or the id.

FLSchiedsrichterBestaetigungResponse.title: FLSchiedsrichterBestaetigungResponse
FLSchiedsrichterBestaetigungResponse.description:
What the person just recorded, read back off the updated document.

Bounded by `READ-REFEREE-002` as the view above is: the page confirms the answer, and a
caller holding a leaked token learns nothing it did not already post.

FLSchiedsrichterKontext.title: FLSchiedsrichterKontext
FLSchiedsrichterKontext.description: What the referee confirmation page's slots name for this record today: the one stored name's first part.

FLSchiedsrichterMint.title: FLSchiedsrichterMint
FLSchiedsrichterMint.description:
A freshly minted link, answered ONCE and stored nowhere.

The raw token exists here and in the recipient's inbox; the database holds its hash. Admin-tier
whole — every mint answering it is on `app/api/schiedsrichter/admin_router.py`.

FLSchiedsrichterMintResponse.title: FLSchiedsrichterMintResponse
FLSchiedsrichterMintResponse.description: The re-send's answer. Never null: where no link may be minted a refusal answers instead.

FLSchiedsrichterReactivateResponse.title: FLSchiedsrichterReactivateResponse
FLSchiedsrichterReactivateResponse.description: The reactivation's answer: its own rather than the retire's, being the one of the pair that can mint.

FLSchiedsrichterSelbst.title: FLSchiedsrichterSelbst
FLSchiedsrichterSelbst.description: One referee record as its own person reads it: their contact details, fee and consent, never the link's bookkeeping.

FLSchiedsrichterSelbstEinwilligungRespon.title: FLSchiedsrichterSelbstEinwilligungResponse
FLSchiedsrichterSelbstEinwilligungRespon.description: The record as it stands after the write, everything the person did not move unchanged.

FLSchiedsrichterSelbstResponse.title: FLSchiedsrichterSelbstResponse
FLSchiedsrichterSelbstResponse.description: Every confirmed referee record the signed-in address holds, the ghost never among them.

FLSchiedsrichterWriteResponse.title: FLSchiedsrichterWriteResponse
FLSchiedsrichterWriteResponse.description:
Shared by delete and anonymisieren.

The retirement answers with the referee as they now stand; the erasure answers with the ghost,
the row it named being gone (`app/api/schiedsrichter/admin_router.py :: anonymise_schiedsrichter`).

FLSitzBestaetigt.title: FLSitzBestaetigt
FLSitzBestaetigt.description: One confirmation a person gave on a row: the seats it answered, its words and the floor its page named.

FLSitzKontext.title: FLSitzKontext
FLSitzKontext.description: What the contact confirmation page's slots name for this seat today.

FLSperrlisteListResponse.title: FLSperrlisteListResponse
FLSperrlisteListResponse.description:
The bans, newest first, and how many there are.

`anzahl_gesamt` is what makes a ban past the cap liftable: one enforced and not rendered is a
person barred by a row nobody can reach.

FLSperrlisteWriteResponse.title: FLSperrlisteWriteResponse
FLSperrlisteWriteResponse.description: The removal is hard, so the id is all there is to answer with: no document survives to echo.

FLSperrlisteZeile.title: FLSperrlisteZeile
FLSperrlisteZeile.description: One ban as the list serves it: the stored row, its author withheld where the ban list holds that address too.

FLSpielAdvancement.title: FLSpielAdvancement
FLSpielAdvancement.description:
One fixture the bracket resolution rewrote, and the result that rewrite destroyed.

Every voided field is `None` where a slot merely filled from empty, so "was anything destroyed"
is a null check.

FLSpielElfmeterschiessen.title: FLSpielElfmeterschiessen
FLSpielElfmeterschiessen.description:
The penalty shoot-out that settled a knockout fixture whose goals finished level.

No `sieger`: a stored one could contradict the counts, and the `$expr` barring it is outside the
database validators' ratified scope (`docs/backend/spec.md :: I25`).

FLSpielJoined.title: FLSpielJoined
FLSpielJoined.description:
One fixture as a BASE-TIER endpoint serves it: stored fields plus each side's joined season state.

A model rather than a default on the stored side, which would make every internal read of a raw
document quietly assert that nobody is disqualified.

FLSpielJoinedAdmin.title: FLSpielJoinedAdmin
FLSpielJoinedAdmin.description:
The same fixture, carrying the two figures the base tier withholds (`READ-MONEY-001`).

A second model rather than a projection per caller: a response whose shape follows the
credential is one no Zod mirror can express.

FLSpielOrtField.title: FLSpielOrtField
FLSpielOrtField.description: The venue as the DOCUMENT holds it, and as the admin editor reads it back to round-trip the rent.

FLSpielOrtFieldPayload.title: FLSpielOrtFieldPayload
FLSpielOrtFieldPayload.description: The venue as the admin PATCH SUBMITS it: which ground, and what this fixture pays for it.

FLSpielOrtFieldPublic.title: FLSpielOrtFieldPublic
FLSpielOrtFieldPublic.description:
The venue as a BASE-TIER read serves it: which ground, and where to find it.

No `mietpreis`: what one fixture agreed to pay is admin-tier (`READ-MONEY-001`).

FLSpielPriorOrt.title: FLSpielPriorOrt
FLSpielPriorOrt.description:
The venue a restore names: which ground, and what that fixture agreed to pay for it.

Lax where `FLSpielOrtFieldPayload` forbids, because a RESPONSE reaches this one
(`docs/backend/spec.md :: I114`), which is also why the two cannot be one class.

FLSpielPriorOtherFields.title: FLSpielPriorOtherFields
FLSpielPriorOtherFields.description:
One fixture's fields as they stood outside its Paarung, and which of them a write REPLACED.

`replaced` rather than omitted keys: a response cannot omit one, and each field's `null` is a
value a restore may write.

FLSpielPriorPaarung.title: FLSpielPriorPaarung
FLSpielPriorPaarung.description:
One fixture this write changed, as it stood before it -- the body `PATCH /spiele/paarungen` takes back.

One entry per FIXTURE and never per rewrite, so a fixture both reports name is restored once.

FLSpielPriorSchiedsrichter.title: FLSpielPriorSchiedsrichter
FLSpielPriorSchiedsrichter.description: The referee a restore names, and the fee that fixture agreed; lax and re-declared for `FLSpielPriorOrt`'s reasons.

FLSpielQuelleGruppe.title: FLSpielQuelleGruppe
FLSpielQuelleGruppe.description: A slot fed by the group phase: the team finishing `platz` in `gruppe`.

FLSpielQuelleSpiel.title: FLSpielQuelleSpiel
FLSpielQuelleSpiel.description: A slot fed by an earlier fixture: the side that came out of match `spiel_nr` as `ausgang`.

FLSpielReleasedSide.title: FLSpielReleasedSide
FLSpielReleasedSide.description:
One side another fixture gave up so a team can play this Spieltag.

`team_name` rather than an id: the message quoting this has no `spiele` list to join against,
and the rename fan-out keeps the copy it reads fresh.

FLSpielSchiedsrichterField.title: FLSpielSchiedsrichterField
FLSpielSchiedsrichterField.description: The referee as the DOCUMENT holds it, and as the admin editor reads it back.

FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPayload.title: FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPayload
FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPayload.description: The referee as the admin PATCH SUBMITS it; `payment` stays for `mietpreis`' reason.

FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPublic.title: FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPublic
FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPublic.description:
The referee as a BASE-TIER read serves it: a forename and a surname initial (`READ-REFEREE-001`).

`payment` is withheld for `mietpreis`' reason.

FLSpielTeamFieldJoined.title: FLSpielTeamFieldJoined
FLSpielTeamFieldJoined.description:
One side as a BASE-TIER read serves it, produced only by `build_spiele_pipeline`.

Narrower than the junction row: every public surface listing a fixture carries this side, and
only a club's own page renders the free text a withdrawal names.

FLSpielTeamFieldPayload.title: FLSpielTeamFieldPayload
FLSpielTeamFieldPayload.description:
One side of a fixture as the admin PATCH SUBMITS it.

No name and no shorthand: the server composes them from the season's `saison_teams` row
(`docs/backend/spec.md :: I3`). A submitted copy is IGNORED rather than refused, as
`docs/backend/spec.md :: I114` allows.

FLSpieleActionRequiredResponse.title: FLSpieleActionRequiredResponse
FLSpieleActionRequiredResponse.description:
The matches needing attention, and why the bracket ones do.

A fault joins its match by `spiel_id`, never `spiel_nr`, which is unique within one season only.
`spiele` carries every match a fault names.

FLSpieleAdminListResponse.title: FLSpieleAdminListResponse
FLSpieleAdminListResponse.description:
The admin surfaces' fixture list.

The base tier reduces a referee's surname to an initial (`READ-REFEREE-001`) and the admin
fixture search matches on that name, so a surname typed there would find nothing.

FLSpieleAdminSingleResponse.title: FLSpieleAdminSingleResponse
FLSpieleAdminSingleResponse.description: What `GET /spiele/{spiel_id}/admin` answers: the fixture the editor round-trips, money included.

FLSpielerAdminSingleResponse.title: FLSpielerAdminSingleResponse
FLSpielerAdminSingleResponse.description:
The same player echoed back to the admin who just wrote them, with their whole name.

`inactive_since` rides here alone: it IS the answer `DELETE` and `reactivate` give, and no public
surface renders a pupil's leaving date.

FLSpielerErasureResponse.title: FLSpielerErasureResponse
FLSpielerErasureResponse.description:
What the erasure removed, and NOT an echo of the person.

A response repeating their names or their consent record would be a fresh copy of exactly what
was erased, handed back over the wire.

FLSpielerKontext.title: FLSpielerKontext
FLSpielerKontext.description:
What the pupil confirmation page's slots name for this record today, so its agreed words render whole.

Null where no squad row names a team and season; the words then render without them.

FLSpielerMembership.title: FLSpielerMembership
FLSpielerMembership.description:
One squad row as seen from its player.

Carries `inactive_since`, which the team junction does not: a player leaves a squad mid-season,
where a team never leaves a season at all.

FLSpielerMembershipsResponse.title: FLSpielerMembershipsResponse
FLSpielerMembershipsResponse.description: Every player, retired ones included, each with their squad rows. Sorted by name.

FLSpielerNachnominierungResponse.title: FLSpielerNachnominierungResponse
FLSpielerNachnominierungResponse.description: Whether an entry into this season's squads today would be marked a Nachnominierung.

FLSpielerPublic.title: FLSpielerPublic
FLSpielerPublic.description:
One squad row as the BASE TIER serves it -- all an anonymous visitor may read.

`build_spieler_pipeline` withholds the rest: the surname is an initial (`READ-PUPIL-001`), the
`stufe` is gone (`READ-PUPIL-002`), and the consent record with it.

FLSpielerSelbst.title: FLSpielerSelbst
FLSpielerSelbst.description: One pupil record as its own person reads it: the whole surname, the birthdate and the consent record, never masked.

FLSpielerSelbstEinwilligungResponse.title: FLSpielerSelbstEinwilligungResponse
FLSpielerSelbstEinwilligungResponse.description: The record as it stands after the write, everything the person did not move unchanged.

FLSpielerSelbstKaderZeile.title: FLSpielerSelbstKaderZeile
FLSpielerSelbstKaderZeile.description: One squad row as its own pupil reads it, with the name the club played that season under.

FLSpielerSelbstResponse.title: FLSpielerSelbstResponse
FLSpielerSelbstResponse.description: The signed-in address's own pupil record: one at most, `spieler.email` being unique.

FLSpielerSingleResponse.title: FLSpielerSingleResponse
FLSpielerSingleResponse.description:
One player as the BASE TIER serves them -- an allow-list of what this surface needs.

Squad fields are season-scoped, and inventing a season would make the answer depend on a default
nobody stated. `nachname` is an INITIAL here (`READ-PUPIL-001`).

FLSpielerWithMemberships.title: FLSpielerWithMemberships
FLSpielerWithMemberships.description:
The person as stored, plus every squad row they hold.

A DIFFERENT question from `FLSpieler`, not a projection: that one is FLATTENED against one
season, so a player in two comes back as two indistinguishable rows.

FLSpielortWriteResponse.title: FLSpielortWriteResponse
FLSpielortWriteResponse.description: Shared by delete and reactivate — both answer with the venue as it now stands.

FLSpielplanShape.title: FLSpielplanShape
FLSpielplanShape.description:
The three rules a season's fixture list is a function of, as this draw is to run from.

All three or none: the draw is one function of the whole shape, and a payload naming half
of it would take the rest off a season about to stop matching it.

FLSubjektPayload.title: FLSubjektPayload
FLSubjektPayload.description: Which mailbox is asking, folded to the one spelling the join, the header and the log agree on.

FLSubjektResponse.title: FLSubjektResponse
FLSubjektResponse.description:
Which confirmed, live records one mailbox matches, and whether the address is on the ban list.

The ban narrows none of the records: whether a barred person signs in is the sign-in gate's to decide.

FLSubjektSchiedsrichter.title: FLSubjektSchiedsrichter
FLSubjektSchiedsrichter.description: One referee record the mailbox names, carrying the id alone for `FLSubjektSpieler`'s reason.

FLSubjektSitz.title: FLSubjektSitz
FLSubjektSitz.description:
One contact seat the mailbox holds on a season's junction row.

Per seat and never per person, as `app/api/kontakte/schemas.py :: FLKontaktSitz` is: one row
seats one person twice where `trainer_ist_zugleich` says so.

FLSubjektSpieler.title: FLSubjektSpieler
FLSubjektSpieler.description:
One pupil record the mailbox names.

The id alone: the caller composed the address it asked about, and anything else here hands a
machine read a fresh copy of somebody's own data for nothing.

FLSwapGruppenPayload.title: FLSwapGruppenPayload
FLSwapGruppenPayload.description:
The two clubs a group swap exchanges. Symmetric.

Neither side carries a `gruppe`: reading one from the payload would let a stale form write a
group nobody stands in.

FLSwapGruppenResponse.title: FLSwapGruppenResponse
FLSwapGruppenResponse.description: Both junction rows as the swap left them, plus `rewritten_spiele` -- the second half of the write, reported not assumed.

kontakte_stand.title: Kontakte Stand
kontakte_stand.description: The token a save against this contact block has to echo back (`docs/backend/spec.md :: I192`).

FLTeamMembership.title: FLTeamMembership
FLTeamMembership.description: One junction row as seen from its club: which season, which group, and the record if any.

FLTeamRecord.title: FLTeamRecord
FLTeamRecord.description:
The club document as it is STORED, and what the write endpoints echo.

The season-scoped fields would mean re-running the team pipeline, whose junction join is strict
-- and a club being created holds no row yet.

FLTeamSitz.title: FLTeamSitz
FLTeamSitz.description:
One seat as the people beside it see it: who holds it and whether they answered their link.

No address, telephone number or birthdate: the contact page promises that only administrators
see those (`fl_backend/app/shared/einwilligung.py :: FASSUNGEN`).

FLTeamSitzeResponse.title: FLTeamSitzeResponse
FLTeamSitzeResponse.description: A team's three seats in one season, in the order `KONTAKT_ROLLEN` names them.

FLTeamWithMemberships.title: FLTeamWithMemberships
FLTeamWithMemberships.description:
The stored club document plus every season membership it holds.

A DIFFERENT question from `FLTeam`, not a projection: that one joins strictly against one season,
so a club outside it is absent by design.

FLTeamWriteResponse.title: FLTeamWriteResponse
FLTeamWriteResponse.description: What the retire and reactivate endpoints echo. `FLTeamRecord`, for the reason stated on it.

FLTeamsGroupedResponse.title: FLTeamsGroupedResponse
FLTeamsGroupedResponse.description:
The season's groups in standing order, and how many of each advance.

`qualifiers_per_group` rides along rather than being fetched separately, so a page cannot mark a
cutoff drawn from a different season than the table it marks.

FLTeamsMembershipsResponse.title: FLTeamsMembershipsResponse
FLTeamsMembershipsResponse.description: Every club, retired ones included, each with its memberships. Sorted by name.

FLTeamsSingleResponse.title: FLTeamsSingleResponse
FLTeamsSingleResponse.description:
One team, from `GET /teams/{team_id}`.

Not part of `FLTeamsResponse`: that union discriminates the shapes ONE endpoint can return.

FLUndrawSpielplanResponse.title: FLUndrawSpielplanResponse
FLUndrawSpielplanResponse.description:
What removing the season's Spielplan took away, on the shape the draw reports.

Both counts are zero on a season already undrawn, which is why the watermark is reported apart:
it is the one thing a season can hold with neither collection behind it.

FLZustellungAbgewiesenPayload.title: FLZustellungAbgewiesenPayload
FLZustellungAbgewiesenPayload.description: A send the provider refused outright. No `nachricht_id`: nothing was minted, so there is no message for a later event to join.

FLZustellungAngenommenPayload.title: FLZustellungAngenommenPayload
FLZustellungAngenommenPayload.description: One message the provider accepted for this record. `stand` is not a key: this endpoint records `angenommen` and no other state.

FLZustellungEreignisPayload.title: FLZustellungEreignisPayload
FLZustellungEreignisPayload.description: One delivery event about a message this record was sent.

FLZustellungResponse.title: FLZustellungResponse
FLZustellungResponse.description:
Whether the write reached the record; false where the report is about a message the record does not hold.

False rather than a refusal: the provider repeats a settled event for hours if anything but a
success answers it.
